description: Question Health Engine — aggregates multiple health signals into a unified 0-100 health score for each CMA Part 1 question.

dataSources.purpose: Primary per-QID source: currentState, defectHistory, challenges, recommendations, sessions, timeline, topic, section, pack, cognitiveLevel, difficulty
Per-QID defect_flags for structural signal (DL-008, DL-026, EV3)
Validates challenge IDs; cross-reference for challenge type/status verification
dataSources.loadStrategy: Optional — primary challenge data comes from question_history.json

dataSources.purpose: Provides recommendation-level metadata (severity, sourceScan) for the recommendation signal

scoringAlgorithm.formula: health_score = max(0, min(100, round(0.30 * defect_score + 0.20 * challenge_score + 0.15 * recommendation_score + 0.15 * certification_score + 0.10 * structural_score + 0.10 * usage_score)))

defect.label: Defect Signal
defect.description: Aggregates known defect codes from defectHistory. Each defect severity imposes a penalty on a 0-100 baseline. Critical defects are an auto-fail (score = 0).
defect.compoundLogic: Sum all per-defect severity penalties. If any Critical defect exists, the score floors to 0 immediately.
defect.scoreFormula: if any defect.severity === 'Critical': defect_score = 0; else: defect_score = max(0, 100 - sum(penalties))

challenge.label: Challenge Signal
challenge.description: Counts OPEN challenges against the question. Only challenges with status === 'OPEN' are counted.
challenge.scoreFormula: openCount = count(challenges where status === 'OPEN'); score = lookupTier(openCount)

recommendation.label: Recommendation Signal
recommendation.description: Counts pending (Open status) recommendations. Each pending remediation/review recommendation deducts points.
recommendation.scoreFormula: pendingCount = count(recommendations where status === 'Open'); recommendation_score = max(0, 100 - pendingCount * 15)

certification.label: Certification Signal
certification.description: Maps the question's governance state (currentState) to a base score.

structural.label: Structural Signal
structural.description: Evaluates structural integrity from work_queue defect_flags: DL-008 (non-empty EW[CC]), DL-026 (empty non-CC EW slots), EV3 (missing accounting principle citation).

DL-008.description: ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] non-empty — learner sees wrong-answer text in correct-answer slot

DL-026.description: Empty non-CorrectChoice ExplanationWrong slots — missing distractor feedback

EV3.description: No accounting principle citation in ExplanationCorrect

structural.scoreFormula: Parse each defect_flag string; apply matching penalty; structural_score = max(0, 100 - sum(penalties))

usage.label: Usage Signal
usage.description: Placeholder for student performance analytics. Currently returns a neutral score (100) because per-question accuracy data is not available in the current registries. In future: session count and student accuracy rates will inform this signal. Questions in many sessions with low accuracy would indicate calibration issues.
usage.scoreFormula: usage_score = 100 (neutral baseline, reserved for future analytics)

healthTiers.description: Question is in excellent condition. No significant defects, no open challenges, certified state.
Question has minor issues. May have 1-2 low-severity defects, 1 open challenge, or pending recommendations.
Question requires remediation. Multiple medium-severity defects, several open challenges, or not certified.
Question is in critical condition. High-severity or critical defects, many open challenges, or archived state.

healthRecord.health_tier: string — HEALTHY | FAIR | NEEDS ATTENTION | CRITICAL

details.total_sessions: number — Count of sessions this question has appeared in

healthRecord.diagnosis: string — Human-readable summary of the primary health concerns

flags.description: Score a single question by QuestionID
Score all 2,540 questions in the pool
Score all questions in a blueprint section (A-F)
Score all questions in a pack (a-e)
Output only aggregate stats (tier distribution, worst 10, best 10)
